purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century collection nodes found through deep search and verified against museum pages datasets or collection studies.
guards: Current aggregate counts are never converted into nineteenth-century slide totals without dated item evidence.
Keep original collecting preparation presentation publication and later museum custody as separate events.
For mixed datasets filter actual slide or microscopic-preparation records before counting.

adapters.target: official Darwin barnacle slide pages and catalogue discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the roughly 300-slide historical corpus as a batch and seek item records; connect slide dates to Darwin's 1846-1854 barnacle work without merging Whipple instrument custody.

adapters.target: official Porifera collection history and emerging Topsent catalogue
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the c.1886 collection-formation anchor but isolate pre-1900 preparations before producing a nineteenth-century slide count.

adapters.institution_scope: Royal Albert Memorial Museum W. B. Carpenter collection
adapters.target: peer-reviewed 1984 slide catalogue and numbered publication-linked series
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract numbered slide ranges locality/genus groupings and publication matches; preserve the later 1903 accession separately.

adapters.institution_scope: Royal Albert Memorial Museum Percy Sladen collection
adapters.target: Linnean Society collection biography plus RAMM institutional collection policy
adapters.promotion_rule: Model the 7186 aggregate hierarchically into Sladen W.B. Carpenter and P.H. Carpenter subcorpora and avoid double-counting separately catalogued Carpenter subsets.

adapters.target: official Challenger collection story and linked object records
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the boxed batch and individual object IDs while leaving the Haeckel-to-Rawson presentation date unresolved unless a source supplies it.

adapters.institution_scope: Leeds Museums and Galleries Discovery Centre
adapters.target: official collection news learning resources and subsequent catalogue endpoint discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Enumerate only explicitly nineteenth-century expedition or dated slides; never use the whole thousands-strong collection as the nineteenth-century count.

adapters.target: official collection history and item-catalogue discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Use 1881 as the collection-formation node and locate surviving preparation/item records before asserting a glass-slide total.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London HMS Challenger sediment collection
adapters.target: official downloadable NHM Data Portal dataset
adapters.promotion_rule: Filter the downloadable records by material container and preparation fields to isolate microscope slides and retain station depth locality and preparation metadata.
